title: A 2-Ton Fish Has No Tail and Lays 300 Million Eggs
subject: ocean sunfish

scenes.text: This two-ton fish has no tail. It swims anyway.
It's the heaviest bony fish in the world, over 2 tons.
Its tail fin never grows. It folds into itself into a rounded rudder.
So it flaps its huge dorsal and anal fins like wings.
It mostly eats jellyfish, and lays up to 300 million eggs.
No tail, two tons, 300 million eggs.

description:
The ocean sunfish weighs about two tons and has no real tail fin.
It swims by flapping its huge dorsal and anal fins, and it can lay up to 300 million eggs.
Have you ever seen one in the wild?
first_comment: Sunfish are often seen basking at the surface, where they get mistaken for sharks. What is the weirdest fish you've seen?
